You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. Then, you can pay two cost to summon a Blue "Champion" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Green] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Green "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
